why_the_new_order_is_safer.principal_reason: Applying CP-01 after registration lets its guards pin the MEASURED root digest instead of a PROJECTED one. The entire class of failure where the projection does not equal the actual value disappears, and that class sits inside the irreversible zone.
why_the_new_order_is_safer.secondary_reason: Under the old order, the interval between applying CP-01 and registering root6 is a state only a successful registration can leave. Registration is the one step that burns the generation id permanently on failure. The new order has no such interval.
why_the_new_order_is_safer.consequence_that_simplifies_the_work: derive-projected-root-digest.sql is no longer needed. Its output, its review, and the hard requirement that the merged registration body stay byte-identical to what CP-01 hashed all fall away, because the digest is measured after the fact rather than predicted.
why_the_new_order_is_safer.cost: none measured. CP-01 has no root-state precondition; all 33 raise statements were read and not one pins the head generation or the event count.
